answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 24279 Country: India Title: I want to marry my phuphi daughter as my my mom fed my phuphi elder son when he was of 2 months as my phuphi was ill. can i marry her? Question: i want to marry my phuphi daughter as my my mom fed my phuphi elder son when he was of 2 months as my phuphi was ill. can i marry her . Answer ID: 24279 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1222/1222/M=1431) You can marry the daughter of your phuphi (sister of your father). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
